item.title: Common Issues
item.description: Sensor Won’t Connect to Wi-Fi Symptoms: LED stays blue flashing, can’t complete setup Solutions: Ensure you’re using a 2.4GHz network (not 5GHz) Move closer to your Wi-Fi router Check that your Wi-Fi password is correct Restart your router and try again Many dual-band routers broadcast both frequencies with the same name. Try temporarily disabling 5GHz during setup. False Presence Detection Symptoms: Sensor reports presence when room is empty Solutions: Check for moving objects (fans, curtains, pets) Reduce sensitivity in app settings Ensure sensor isn’t pointing at windows or reflective surfaces Run manual calibration with room empty No Presence Detection Symptoms: Sensor doesn’t detect when someone is present
